verdict.rationale: Mollie documents a Settlement Report giving a complete breakdown of each payout, covering all transactions, fees and deductions. A Settlements API and a Balances API with historical data support reconciliation. Nothing in the evidence shows a finance-ops user can control the payout schedule (frequency or timing), so only half the story is delivered. Missing for 10: payout schedule control, explicit evidence that refunds and chargebacks are itemized per payout, independent or hands-on corroboration.
